en: Wooloo on the line again! The driver says we could be sat here till teatime.
Motostoke's only on the far side of the Wild Area, though. We'll walk it! There's no better way to meet strong Pokémon.
See you at the steps under the city, {player}. Last one there buys the curry!
The line north is blocked by Wooloo, I'm afraid. Trains still run back south to Wedgehurst, though.
Enjoy the Wild Area! Do keep an eye on the weather. It changes the Pokémon about as much as the scenery.
Welcome! I trade in Watts, the energy the dens' light gives off. You have {var:VAR_GALAR_WATTS} W.
Come back with more Watts! Touch a den's beam of light and they're yours.
A pleasure doing business! You have {var:VAR_GALAR_WATTS} W left.
Not quite enough Watts for that one, I'm afraid.
Balls! I love Poké Balls! Every shape, every colour. Here, have one of today's favourites!
Come back tomorrow! I'll have a new favourite by then. I always do.
